statement: Under Definitions 5, 8, 9 and equations (10)--(12) of Alexandersson--Jal--Quemener, arXiv:2502.05939v1, take the non-skew Ferrers board lambda=(3,3,3,3,4,4) and content alpha=(2,2,1,1). There are exactly 60 legal words with strict adjacent ascents and no sentinel, and the first-entry refinements are R3=t(t^2+8t+3), R2=t(8t^2+15t+1), and R1=t^2(t+7)(2t+1). The sequence (R3,R2,R1) is not interlacing: its required ordered pair R3 preceq R1 fails because their degrees are 3 and 4 and minroot(R3)=-4-sqrt(13)<-7=minroot(R1). Thus the interlacing clause of Conjecture 28 is false, disproving the exact original conjunction frozen in source.md. This does not decide the separately quantified total real-rootedness clause. Indeed, all three refinements and the total R=2t(t^3+12t^2+15t+2) in this witness are real-rooted. No minimality or universal total-polynomial counterexample is asserted.
contribution: An explicit nonrectangular Ferrers-board counterexample with repeated positive content to the conjectured multiset refinement interlacing, with a complete finite counting certificate and an elementary exact root inequality. The research pass independently reconstructed the full word set by two new methods, checked every inherited word and ascent count, verified the primary definitions, and supplied an integer sign-change proof for the real-rooted total. No equivalent counterexample was found in the bounded primary-source comparisons recorded on 2026-09-13; this is not a worldwide priority claim. Fresh referee review of correctness, logical scope and contribution is requested.
